title: Cross-Scale Spatial Golden Proof
objective: Prove one end-to-end cross-scale spatial package from imported or assembled local structure through irregular room/topology semantics and an interactable ISE Scene to world-scale migration, sanctuary and research relationships plus era/state change, with provenance, accessibility and canonical owner-domain boundaries intact.

bounded_contract.stable_reference_contract: One bounded golden package carries stable semantic reference IDs and provenance across every stage and scale; views, geometry and projections cannot mint competing canonical identity.
bounded_contract.owner_contract: Scene, MAI, ISE, World/Reality, Event, Research, Creature ecology, Permission/entitlement, provider/media-rights and other owner domains remain canonical; SSA-10 composes proof only and creates no duplicate owner ledger.
bounded_contract.state_separation_contract: Geometry, semantic structure, topology, historical state and live owner state remain distinct across the golden package.
bounded_contract.authorization_contract: Authorization precedes projection; hidden/GM-only semantics and protected cardinality are filtered before any projected proof surface.
bounded_contract.accessibility_contract: Every consequential golden-package stage has an accessible nonvisual summary/equivalent carrying the same governed semantic identity.
bounded_contract.determinism_contract: Equivalent authorized inputs serialize and receipt deterministically independent of input ordering, view, modality and platform; wall-clock timing is not semantic truth or an acceptance oracle.
bounded_contract.persistence_decision: No durable SSA-10 persistence is required; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
bounded_contract.successor_boundary: WCI-01+, tester distribution, paid provider activation, release and deployment remain unauthorized.

acceptance_contract: Test-first RED must prove the bounded SSA-10 golden-package contract/panel do not exist before production implementation.

One golden package must compose local structure, irregular topology, semantic construction roles, an interactable ISE Scene projection, world-scale migration/sanctuary/research relations and Event/era spatial state change over stable references.
Cross-scale composition must preserve owner-domain identities and cannot create duplicate canonical truth or owner ledgers.
Authorization and hidden-cardinality filtering must occur before every projected proof surface; consequential stages require provenance and accessible nonvisual summaries.
Geometry, semantic structure, topology, historical state and live owner state must remain distinct through composition.
Equivalent authorized package inputs must produce deterministic serialization and receipts independent of ordering, modality/view and Linux/Windows platform.
No durable SSA-10 persistence, migration 0022, provider activation, canonical owner mutation or WCI ownership is introduced.
Final validation uses exactly one SSA-10 current-family profile, self-hosted Linux, self-hosted Windows and deterministic comparator with zero predecessor fanout.
